name: Viro Filter Map & Store Locator
author: Viroproject

sections.description:
Viro Filter Map & Store Locator is a next-generation Store Locator for WordPress, designed to be blazing fast and visually stunning out-of-the-box.

Unlike older plugins that rely on heavy libraries like jQuery, Viro Filter Map & Store Locator is built with Vanilla Javascript and the native WordPress REST API. This guarantees instant loading times, smooth map interactions, and zero conflicts with your theme or page builders.

With its modern CSS Grid layout, it perfectly adapts to any device, offering a native app-like experience to your users. Add your locations, assign categories, and let your customers find your physical stores, offices, or distributors effortlessly.

🌟 Free Features

  • OpenStreetMap Integration: Free, reliable, and requires no complicated API keys to start.
  • Modern Grid Layout: A clean UI with filters on the left, the map on top, and a responsive grid of location cards below.
  • Instant Filtering: Users can search by name/address or filter by categories instantly without reloading the page.
  • App-like Map Popups: Beautiful map markers that open modern, edge-to-edge image popups with contact details.
  • Click-to-Call & Email: Integrated quick links for phone numbers and email addresses.
  • Gutenberg & Page Builder Ready: Just drop the [virofpl_locator] shortcode anywhere (works perfectly with Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, etc.).
  • Zero Bloat: No jQuery, no heavy assets. Pure performance.

🚀 Need More Power? Discover the PRO Version!

If you are an agency, a franchise, or simply need advanced features, Viro Filter Map & Store Locator PRO takes your map to the next level:
* Google Maps & Mapbox Support
* Automatic Coordinate Finder (1-Click address to Lat/Lng conversion)
* Custom Map Pins (Upload your own icons)
* Advanced Pagination (Load More button or Numeric)
* CSV Mass Importer (Create hundreds of locations in 1 click)
* 1-Click Migration from WeLaunch Store Locator
* Multiple Premium Layouts

External Services

This plugin connects to a third-party API to provide geolocation functionalities:

OpenStreetMap (Nominatim API)
* Purpose: Used only in the WordPress admin backend. When an administrator types a physical address and clicks “Find Coordinates”, the plugin uses this service to automatically convert the address into Latitude and Longitude to place the map pin.
* Data Sent: Only the text string of the typed address is sent to the API upon explicit button click. No visitor data or personal identifiable information is transmitted.
* Service Provider: OpenStreetMap Foundation.
* Terms of Use: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/nominatim/
* Privacy Policy: https://wiki.osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/viro-filter-map-store-locator directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the new “Locations” menu in your WordPress admin panel and add your store locations.
  4. (Optional) Create Categories to group your locations.
  5. Go to “Locations -> Settings” to configure your default map coordinates and colors.
  6. Insert the shortcode [virofpl_locator] into any page or post to display your map.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API Key to make the map work?

No! The free version uses OpenStreetMap, which is 100% free and ready to use immediately. No registration or API keys are required.

Can I use Google Maps instead?

Google Maps support (along with Mapbox) is available in the PRO version.

How do I display the map on my site?

Simply create a new Page or Post and paste the shortcode [virofpl_locator].

Can I import my locations from an Excel/CSV file?

The CSV Mass Importer (and the automated migration tool from WeLaunch Store Locator) is a premium feature available in Viro Filter Map & Store Locator PRO.

Can the plugin find coordinates automatically?

Yes! Viro Filter Map & Store Locator PRO includes a magical button that automatically finds Latitude and Longitude based on your typed address.
